answered.sql: SELECT T1.title FROM Films AS T1 JOIN Film_Genres AS T2 ON T1.film_id = T2.film_id JOIN Genres AS T3 ON T2.film_genre_id = T3.id WHERE T3.genre IN ('Action', 'Adventure') AND T1.film_id IN (SELECT film_id FROM Film_Stars WHERE film_star_id = (SELECT id FROM Stars WHERE star_name = 'Tom Cruise'))

candidates.meaning: Display action films and adventure films which star Tom Cruise.
candidates.sql: SELECT F.title FROM Films F JOIN Film_Genres FG ON F.film_id = FG.film_id JOIN Genres G ON FG.film_genre_id = G.id JOIN Film_Stars FS ON F.film_id = FS.film_id JOIN Stars S ON FS.film_star_id = S.id WHERE S.star_name = 'Tom Cruise' AND (G.genre = 'Action' OR G.genre = 'Adventure')

candidates.meaning: Display films where Tom Cruise is a star and the film genre is either Action or Adventure.
candidates.sql: SELECT F.title FROM Films F JOIN Film_Stars FS ON F.film_id = FS.film_id JOIN Stars S ON FS.film_star_id = S.id WHERE S.star_name = 'Tom Cruise' AND F.film_id IN (SELECT film_id FROM Film_Genres WHERE film_genre_id IN (SELECT id FROM Genres WHERE genre IN ('Action', 'Adventure'))) ORDER BY F.title

candidates.meaning: Display films where Tom Cruise is a star and the film genre is Action, and separately display films where Tom Cruise is a star and the film genre is Adventure.
candidates.sql: SELECT 'Action' AS genre, F.title FROM Films F JOIN Film_Genres FG ON F.film_id = FG.film_id JOIN Film_Stars FS ON F.film_id = FS.film_id JOIN Stars S ON FS.film_star_id = S.id WHERE S.star_name = 'Tom Cruise' AND FG.film_genre_id = (SELECT id FROM Genres WHERE genre = 'Action') UNION SELECT 'Adventure' AS genre, F.title FROM Films F JOIN Film_Genres FG ON F.film_id = FG.film_id JOIN Film_Stars FS ON F.film_id = FS.film_id JOIN Stars S ON FS.film_star_id = S.id WHERE S.star_name = 'Tom Cruise' AND FG.film_genre_id = (SELECT id FROM Genres WHERE genre = 'Adventure') ORDER BY genre, title
